svg.aria-label: Sender (context): Submits or retries messages. Gateway (in focus): Holds client connections. Recipient (in focus): Reads new and missed messages. Chat service (in focus): Orders writes. Message store (context): Durable history. Delivery queue (added) (in focus): Durable delivery events. Delivery worker (added) (in focus): Routes stored messages. Use current directory entry. Connection directory (added) (in focus): Finds live gateways. Expire stale entries. Flow: Chat service to Delivery queue: Publish event. Delivery queue to Delivery worker: Consume event. Delivery worker to Connection directory: Find gateway. Delivery worker to Gateway: Send to gateway. Gateway to Recipient: Push the message.
